question: Which entirely unmaterialized 3RScan family should test the frozen full-frame class-agnostic proposal, target-only mask-foreground FFA memory and native SAM2 refinement chain?

selection.ranking: Use unchanged metadata candidate order; exclude governed consumed targets, used reference families, and every candidate whose scans already have semseg, instance PLY, or sequence materialized. Select the first remaining row before pose, depth, RGB or model access.

post_download_gate.memory_selection: Greedily maximize newly visible target vertices on each scan; ties use larger short-side fraction, higher depth-visible ratio, then earlier frame.
post_download_gate.source_is_evaluable_only_if: Both target scans yield at least two memory views before RGB/model access. A same-scene sibling is recorded when available but is not an input to target-only ranking.

forbidden_after_freeze: replace selected family, target or six-file download plan
change view admission or three-view memory selection
add a sibling-negative term or open RGB before source admission
claim a metadata candidate or source gate as confirmation
claim_boundary: This freezes only the next new physical family candidate for target-only FFA localization. It is metadata-only, not source evaluability, algorithm evidence, referent binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
